strike.text: n Shield. Gold mineralisation is extremely widespread within the NTS, with nearly every hole completed over a strike length of approximately 1.8 km, and from surface to a depth of almost 1,000 m intersecting

depth.text: multiple zones of mineralisation in individual holes, and the vertical extent of mineralisation from surface to approximately 850 m below surface (and open to depth). Drilling has been carried out on fans

metallurgy.summary: sulphide ore, arsenic-bearing, acid-consuming; processed by flotation to concentrate, then cyanide leach (CIL/CIP), then gravity recovery; stated recovery Au 91%
